datasheet_identity.title: AO3403 30V P-Channel Enhancement Mode Field Effect Transistor

extraction_notes: The datasheet specifies a P-channel device and prints drain, gate, source, and diode quantities with negative signs. Per the bundled VDMOS archetype, this extraction records magnitudes and polarity = p.
Transfer, on-region, and reverse-transfer-capacitance curves were manually digitized from the typical plots on p. 3-p. 4 using magnitudes.

The electrical table also publishes IDSS, IGSS, transconductance, gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery time, reverse-recovery charge, and gate resistance; this extraction schema has no fields for those quantities.

The table also provides maximum RDS(on) values of 0.115 ohm at |VGS|=10 V, 0.150 ohm at |VGS|=4.5 V, and 0.200 ohm at |VGS|=2.5 V, while the schema resistance fields retain the corresponding typical values.
Ciss is 260 pF typical (2.6e-10 F) and 315 pF maximum under the shared dynamic-parameter bias VGS=0 V, VDS=-15 V, f=1 MHz; the schema field retains the typical value.
